summary: Produced a Type E design artefact for Stage F3 batch 1 frontend requirements IN-UI-01 through IN-UI-04 at src/design/f3-instance-monitoring-ui.md. The artefact classifies each requirement with rationale and defines component hierarchy, route/query state model, API integration points, public interfaces, error taxonomy, state transitions, dependencies, coverage mapping, and open questions for clarified contracts.
